institution.reference: Synthetic institution for the schema-mutation suite; not a real body.

governed_context.description: Applications for the synthetic baseline permit decided and registered by the Baseline Permitting Authority. This embedded object is a GovernedContextDescriptor — a description of what class of matters the protocol governs — and carries no runtime members: runtime GovernedContext instances (with protocol_version_id and protocol_version_hash pins) live outside the ProtocolVersion, so no artifact embeds a hash of the object containing it.
governed_context.scope: Single synthetic permit lifecycle: one decision act and one registration act.
governed_context.jurisdiction_note: XX-BASELINE (synthetic jurisdiction for the schema-mutation suite; not a real body).

commitment_points.name: Permit decision
commitment_points.description: Authoritative disposition of the baseline application among allowed outcomes.

binding_effect_basis.downstream_consequence: Refusal blocks the governed activity until recourse concludes.

reasoning.rule: Grant if all Baseline Statute s.3 criteria are met; refuse otherwise.

commitment_points.name: Decision registration
commitment_points.description: Constitutive attestation that the permit decision has been entered in the public register.

reasoning.rule: Record the decision outcome verbatim in the register.

recourse.source: Registration is mechanical; challenge lies against the underlying decision (cp-baseline-decide).
